summary: Customer wants an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to follow growth and notice changes earlier. Biomass and metabolic signals are mentioned but not defined as separate targets. Broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops. They ask for help turning this into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.
